Name: Mannequin Roulette
Author: pheauxm
Description:
What if cursed mannequins were (almost) guaranteed to swap outfits with the farmer at the end of the day? And what if that wasn't limited to cursed mannequins, so you could get the fun gamble of not knowing which outfit you get to wear without getting blocked in bed by a cursed mannequin teleporting in front of you? And what if... you could keep your boots?

This mod gives each mannequin in the house a chance to swap outfits with the farmer after sleeping. If the "Include Farmer" config option is checked, then the farmer also has a chance to keep their outfit on. This chance is equal between each participant; so 2 mannequins without "Include Farmer" each have a 50% chance to be chosen, and turning "Include Farmer" on gives each mannequin a 33% chance to be chosen and the farmer a 33% chance to keep their outfit.

This does NOT override the usual mannequin swap. So if you have cursed mannequins, there's a possibility you can swap with this mod, and then swap again with the cursed mannequin's original chance to swap.

[size=5]configs[/size]
[u]Accessible through [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url][/u]
[b]Active Roulette[/b] - Turn roulette off or on in-game. Default true.
[b]Type of Mannequin [/b]- What type of mannequin can swap outfits with the farmer. Default "Cursed".
[b]Include Farmer[/b] - If true, farmer has a chance to keep their outfit. Default true.
[b]Swap Boots[/b] - If true, mannequins swap boots when swapping outfits. Default false. (Since boots give the player benefits, I find it kind of a hassle if I swap and have to go find which mannequin stole my boots.)
